reviewer: implementing agent, by opening the PNGs
subject: the renderer, using the in-repo capsule hand as the only source

renderer_checks.skin_shading_smooth: pass: no facet glitter; hard block rims stay crisp through the crease angle
renderer_checks.hand_fills_about_70_percent: pass: measured fill 0.64 to 0.70 on the longer axis in all 42 frames
renderer_checks.key_fill_rim_lights_no_headlight: pass, with a limit: there are no cast shadows, so fingers lack a contact shadow on the grip
renderer_checks.club_visible: partial: grip rubber in every view; the steel shaft stub is in frame only in the eye view
renderer_checks.lead_and_trail_mirror: pass: the trail fingers curl the opposite way and the views keep their names for both hands

palm.note: fingers across the grip read clearly; flat without contact shadows; shaft out of frame

back.note: clean gradient across the dorsum; shaft out of frame

thumb_side.note: depth reads from the key and rim lights; shaft out of frame

butt.note: framing is right; the butt cap is a flat near-black disc; shaft hidden behind the grip

eye.note: grip and shaft both visible; best single view

capsule_anatomy_checklist.cupped_palm: fail: the capsule palm is a curved block
capsule_anatomy_checklist.no_tubes_blobs_or_torn_triangles: fail: the capsule hand is tubes by construction; no torn triangles
capsule_anatomy_checklist.note: these lines judge the capsule source, which is known to be crude, not the renderer

known_limits: MuJoCo shadow maps showed acne and serrated edges at this scale, so shadows are off in settings
wrap and subsurface tint are only a warm ambient term in the MuJoCo engine
the matplotlib fallback is faceted and is not quality-bar evidence
